sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Each example contains the correction, not just the answer.

items.prompt: A function contains the points (1, 5) and (3, 13). Write the function rule f(x) = mx + b.

steps: Use one point to find b: 5 = 4(1) + b, so b = 1.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $30 base fee plus $15 per hour. Which function models the total cost f(x) for x hours?

steps: The base fee of $30 is charged even with 0 hours, so it is the initial value b.
The $15 per hour charge is the constant rate of change m.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Before solving, say which error the problem is testing for.

items.prompt: A tank of water drains at a steady rate until it is empty. Which description best matches the shape of the graph over time?
choices: increasing, then constant, then decreasing
constant, then increasing
decreasing at a constant rate the whole time
increasing at a constant rate the whole time

items.prompt:
A graph shows height over time.
From t = 0 to t = 6, height goes from 19 to 19.
From t = 6 to t = 7, height goes from 19 to 22.
From t = 7 to t = 8, height goes from 22 to 20.
Which interval shows the height constant?
choices: t = 0 to t = 6
t = 6 to t = 7
No interval shows this behavior.
t = 7 to t = 8

items.prompt: Consider the relation {(9, -6), (-4, -8), (-3, -8), (-4, 0)}. Is this relation a function?
choices: Yes, this relation is a function.
It is a function only if every output is different.
Cannot be determined from the given pairs.
No, this relation is not a function.

items.prompt: Which set of ordered pairs does NOT represent a function?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Given f(x) = 4x + 10, find the value of x for which f(x) = 18.

Function B is given by f(x) = 3x - 25. Function A is given by the table:
x: 4, 8
y: -23, -51
Which function has the greater rate of change?
choices: Function B
They have the same rate of change.
Function A
Cannot be determined from the given information.

items.prompt: Function B is given by f(x) = 2x + 21. Function A starts at 15 and increases by 7 each unit. Which function has the greater value when x = 2?
choices: Function B
Function A
Cannot be determined without a graph.
The two functions have equal values at that input.
